inputs.unit: u in px, 2..12 (size / data-size attribute sets --ui-unit per subtree)
inputs.gap: gutter in u, 0..8 in 0.5 steps (gap attribute)

invariants: box-sizing: border-box everywhere; each owner deducts its own border once (pad = u − B).
Slots are fixed at 6u; density never shrinks slots, icons or type.
Lengths reach CSS through the variables styles/geometry.ts derives from the inputs; components never hard-code a length.
Change resolve.ts and styles/geometry.ts together, then regenerate docs/geometry.csv and tokens/dtcg/.

control.summary: Height 8u = 6u slot + 2·pad. Construction pattern [leading] [prefix] [contents] [suffix] [trailing]: icon slots 6u; the text run (prefix, label, suffix) has 0.5u beside another text part, 1u beside a slot, 2u at a bare edge. Font 10px + u. Icon = font + k·u (sm −0.5, md +0.5, lg +1.5), capped at the slot.

field.summary: The control family applied to field hosts: the input control ([leading] [prefix] [editor] [suffix] [trailing]) and select trigger ([leading] [prefix] [value] [suffix] [chevron]) have pad = u − B and use the control text-run rule; the chevron is icon size sm.

field-row.summary: Field rows place a label, a control, a readout and a description; the control keeps its own geometry. Stacked: label above, row gap 1.5u, label-to-unit 1u. Inline: label | control | readout, column gap 2u, row gap 1u to the description, the unit at least 2u from the label text. Field grid: column and row gap 2u, label column content-sized up to 40% of the grid, readout column at least 10u; a heading after the first has 4u above it. Lengths are spacing and sizes tokens in u (resolveFieldRow, resolveFieldGrid).

btg.summary: Badge, tag and chip heights on the 12px + k·u ladder. Spacing uses a local unit u′ = height / 8: host 0.5u′ − B, slots height − u′, labels 1u′ on both sides (chip 1.5u′ at a bare edge), text parts 0.5u′ apart. Radius is concentric with the slot: (0.5u′ + slot / 3) × curvature, pill at height / 2 (the button's 1u + 6u / 3 = 3u). Icon containers are a set size: the slot, square.

choice.summary: Checkbox box (radius 1u), radio dot (circle) and switch track (capsule) inside a 6u leading slot. The indicator is the leading slot; the text run follows with a 0 bare end edge.

track.summary: 4u track rounded at half height. Range thumb inside it like a switch thumb (track − u, inset 0.5u, concentric radius), travelling width − track; the fill ends one track-radius past the thumb center (track + p·(width − track)) with the track radius, so its cap wraps the thumb. Progress fill = p·width. The ratio arrives as --ui-ratio. Meter: the progress track under a label | value row (control text, column gap 2u) 1.5u above it (resolveMeter).

swatch.summary: 6u swatch; palettes join swatches with no gap and round only the outer corners.

swiper.summary: Paddles are control-family 8u icon buttons inset 2u, fully round; dots 2u (the active one 4u wide) in 4u hit areas, u apart, 2u above the bottom edge.
swiper.ladderWaiver: A carousel per size would dwarf the page; the Components page shows the swiper at the theme unit and the Geometry page lists its paddle and dot sizes.

image.summary: A square-cornered frame (radius 0) whose height is width / ratio for a preset (square 1/1, landscape 4/3, portrait 3/4, wide 16/9, ultrawide 21/9, story 9/16, golden 1.618/1) or a custom "w/h"; with no or an invalid ratio the content sets the height. A slideshow fills the frame with a swiper (the swiper family's paddles and dots).
image.ladderWaiver: An image frame has no u-based length of its own (its height follows its width and ratio); the slideshow controls are the swiper's, also waived.

choice-group.summary: Choice groups place their 6u choice rows (the choice family) 1u apart, a 7u pitch like composite items; horizontal: 4u between choices (a choice label has no end padding), wrapping with 1u between lines. The gap attribute (g·u) replaces the gap along the direction. No padding, border or radius of their own.

fieldset.summary: A fieldset stacks its legend and fields with the collection gap of the container ladder (theme gap-collection, default 2u; the gap attribute wins) and draws no box: padding, border and radius 0, so the fields keep their own edges and a surrounding card supplies the surface. The legend is the title type role.

container.summary: Three families. Wrapper: composite 0.5u, group 1u, collection 2u; radius concentric with 3u children (3u + padding). Container: card padding xs 2u, sm 3u, md 4u, lg 5u, xl 6u; radius = padding (corner scale lowers, never raises). Area: panel 6u, region 8u, page 8u (+72rem max width); square. Gap defaults to the level padding.

separator.summary: A rule as thick as the theme border, never thinner than a hairline: max(1px, B), B = min(border, u/2). Horizontal spans the inline axis, vertical stretches across its flex or grid line; no padding or margin of its own (the container gap spaces it).

avatar.summary: A square on the slot and control ladder: sm 6u (the slot), md 8u (the control height, default), lg 12u, xl 16u. A control scaled by k = size / 8u: initials (10px + u)·k at line height 1.2, fallback icon (10px + 1.5u)·k (the md icon). Round: radius size/2 × min(1, s).

disclosure.summary: Collapsible (and accordion) triggers are control rows: 8u, padding u − B, the construction pattern with a trailing caret at icon size sm, the control radius, full width. The panel's text starts at the trigger's label edge (1u + 2u = 3u) and ends 2u below its content; its height animates between 0 and auto on the reveal intent. Accordion items are collapsibles separated by the thin (1px) border-width token outside their padding: a closed item is 8u + 1px at any B. Tabs: the list sits 2u from its panels; segmented tabs are composite options (7u) in an 8u composite list with the indicator as the active tab's raised fill; underline tabs are 8u control rows over a thin (1px) track with a 0.5u indicator bar (radius 0.25u).

menu.summary: Menu triggers are control rows (8u, padding u − B, the control radius, the construction pattern with a trailing caret at icon size sm). The popup is a floating composite 1u from its anchor (edge D = max(B, 0.5u), padding D − B, the composite gap, the wrapper radius (3 + 0.5)u · s), at least as wide as the anchor and as tall as the space allows. Items, submenu triggers and group labels are composite options (7u, inset Ic, the concentric option radius) with labels 2u from a bare edge and 1u from a slot; checkbox and radio items keep a 6u leading indicator slot; separators are max(1px, B) with 0.5u above and below. Submenus sit 1u beside their trigger. A context menu has no trigger geometry (the area is the author's); its popup opens 1u from the pointer.
